cli-actions.label: Load repository defaults
cli-actions.command: gh aw env get cao-governance.yml --scope repo --repo {{repository}}

cli-actions.label: Apply repository defaults
cli-actions.command: gh aw env update cao-governance.yml --scope repo --repo {{repository}} --yes

cli-actions.label: Load organization defaults
cli-actions.command: gh aw env get cao-governance.yml --scope org --org {{organization}}

cli-actions.label: Apply organization defaults
cli-actions.command: gh aw env update cao-governance.yml --scope org --org {{organization}} --visibility {{visibility}} --yes

cli-actions.label: Load enterprise defaults
cli-actions.command: gh aw env get cao-governance.yml --scope ent --enterprise {{enterprise}}

cli-actions.label: Apply enterprise defaults
cli-actions.command: gh aw env update cao-governance.yml --scope ent --enterprise {{enterprise}} --visibility {{visibility}} --yes

pages.title: Governance

pages.subject: Non-secret GitHub Actions compiler default variables and their inherited repository reach.
pages.objective: Review the complete defaults document before approving scoped changes.
pages.acceptance: Load the selected scope and preview all sets and deletions before approval; preserve narrower overrides and visibility, report access failures, and never grant CAO rollout authority.
pages.description: Review inherited gh-aw compiler defaults before approving a scoped configuration change.
